title: Signature Healing Garden Burn
concept: A garden where burn survivors do therapy among plants — reaching, walking, breathing fresh air. Nature heals alongside medicine. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on indoor-only with a therapeutic garden.
patient_flow: Major burns arrive via trauma systems to verified burn centers; resuscitation starts immediately with Parkland-calculated fluids. Wounds are assessed daily — depth determines grafting. Surgeries stage over weeks: debridement, grafting, reconstruction. Rehabilitation — splinting, pressure garments, therapy — continues for years after discharge.
code_demo:
# Signature Healing Garden Burn — Signature design prototype
def parkland_fluids(weight_kg, tbsa_percent):
    """Parkland formula: 4 mL x kg x %TBSA in first 24h (half in first 8h)."""
    total = 4 * weight_kg * tbsa_percent
    return (f"24h total: {total:.0f} mL LR | first 8h: {total/2:.0f} mL "
            f"({total/16:.0f} mL/hr), next 16h: {total/2:.0f} mL")
print(parkland_fluids(70, 40))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
